warhead.provenance: 1,000-lb class unitary warhead per OOB (csg-us-tomahawk-navy, A) = 453.6 kg. Explosive/case split, lethal radius, and damage are engineering-estimate surrogates; no public HE fraction admitted.

fuze.provenance: Land-attack unitary warhead fuzing is not detailed in the OOB; engineering-estimate impact/delay fuze scaffold typical of a 1,000-lb class land-attack warhead.

_real_world.speed: High subsonic; Tier C ~0.75 Mach / ~880 km/h (not verified)
_real_world.guidance_real: INS, TERCOM, DSMAC, GPS; two-way satcom retargeting, loiter capability
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — no NavalWeaponType exists for land-attack cruise missiles; placed only in _real_world.weapon_inventory on ship records

warhead.type.note: blast: no public detonation-mechanism detail beyond the 1,000-lb class unitary warhead mass; generic blast is the nearest real engine-recognized warhead type

guidance.type.note: INS/TERCOM/DSMAC/GPS waypoint land-attack guidance; no active seeker for this non-MST variant. The engine's guidance.type string loader (unit_definition_loader.cpp:1506-1512) only recognizes ActiveRadar/Radar or IR/Infrared as a seeker_type; a waypoint-guidance missile has no matching engine seeker category, and this record has no functional mount anyway (mechanism gap), so the field is descriptive metadata only

guidance.active_seek_range.note: 0.0: no active terminal seeker exists on this land-attack variant (unlike the MST variant), consistent with guidance.type
